premises.scope: pointwise Fresnel correction and diagonal same-sign-pair pi theorem
exact bathtub reduction to unit-measure product-set shell volume

regularity_status: Diagonal branch has bounded uniformly continuous density at C=pi. Principal-triple branch has absolute continuity plus L-infinity bound; continuous representative not proved in general.
mechanism_obstruction: Flat rank-three Hadamard projectors satisfy three eigenvalues=1 but every principal triple sigma_min<=3/n, so a single-coordinate-triple selection is dimension-losing.
unresolved_implication: Aggregate principal triple/minor information, e.g. sum_{|I|=3} det(U_I)^2=1 for rank-three projector U U^T, into a dimension-free product-set shell-volume bound without selecting one minor.
next_step: Attack the flat rank-three projector product-set shell geometry from the account03/B15 reduction using determinant-weighted multilinear coarea or Brascamp-Lieb. Keep the stronger continuity question separate from central L-infinity.
